releaseNotes:
v4.0.0
		✅ Framework is rename from Rapid.Agentic.AI.Framework to CoreAgentra to reflect broader capabilities beyond RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
		v3.2.6
		✅ Enhanced Vector Storage: Improved metadata, enabling better filtering, traceability, and relevance in retrieval. This makes your RAG system more scalable, accurate, and easier to debug.

		v3.2.3
		Bug Fix:
		✅ Files saved as UTF-8 with a Byte Order Mark (BOM) are now correctly recognized and processed as ASCII.

		v3.2.0
		✅ Following PowerPoint formats support added
		.pptx – Presentation
		.pptm – Macro-enabled Presentation
		.ppsx – Slide Show
		.ppsm – Macro-enabled Slide Show
		.potx – Template
		.potm – Macro-enabled Template
		✅ Any ASCII text file

		v3.1.1
		✅ AuditTrail support implemented

		v3.0.1
		✅ Log improved

		v3.0.0
		✅ Log improved

		v2.1.9
		Bug Fix:
		✅ In client upload mode, server side the RAG db saved to wrong location and issue is fixed
		✅ Response data from RAG API improved

		v2.1.8
		New Features:
		✅ RAG Context Retrieval support
		New API IRagGateway.RetrieveContextAsync is introduced to query the context to pass it to other AI tool along with prompt

		v2.1.7
		New Features:
		✅ Excel (.xlsx) Ingestion Support
		Added support for importing .xlsx files into the RAG ingestion pipeline.
		Each row is treated as a document chunk with optional metadata (source, sheet name, row number), making it easy to embed tabular knowledge into vector stores.

		v2.1.6
		Improved Chunking Strategy:
		- Token Chunking enabled using embedding model "text-embedding-ada-002"
		- Word-based chunking improved, ensuring semantic integrity of each chunk.
		- Configurable chunk window size (default: 150 words) with optional stride for overlapping context (e.g., 75 words).
		- This provides better alignment with natural language boundaries and improves retrieval relevance during vector search.

		v2.1.5
		New Feature: Extended Document Format Support
		- Added support for additional document formats including:
		- Microsoft Word (.docx) files
		- HTML files
		- Markdown files
		- PDF files
		- c# solution files (.sln). Along with .sln file, all .csproj (C# project) files referenced in the solution and all .cs files referenced in the projects are also processed.
		- c# project files (.csproj). Along with .csproj file, all .cs files referenced in the project are also processed.
		- C# source code files (.cs)
		- .bat files
		- .txt files
		- All these formats can be processed for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) vector database generation.

		Improvements (also check readme file)
		- Improved RAG vector database generation
		- Improved Sentence Tokenizer
		- Improved Context Search
		Bug Fixes
		- Fixed wrong model usage in generating string embedding for storing.

		Automatically uploading of c# .cs files from given .csproj or .sln files
		- Automatically identifies and uploads then generates vector database for RAG:
		- All .csproj and .cs files from a given .sln (solution) file and .sln file itesf
		- All .cs files referenced in each .csproj (C# project) file.
